items.stem: Training loss is NaN after a few steps. Which cause is most likely?

options.text: The learning rate is too high, causing diverging updates
options.rationale: Correct: an excessive learning rate commonly produces NaNs.

options.text: The dataset has too many samples
options.rationale: Dataset size does not cause NaNs.
Dropout alone does not cause NaN loss.

options.text: The model was moved to the GPU
options.rationale: Device placement does not cause NaNs.
